build_alphastar_agent: build an AlphaStarAgent with a modular component and optional JIT compilation settings
create_agent_initial_state: create the initial state for an AlphaStarAgent given an RNG key and batch size
init_agent_parameters: initialize agent parameters by calling init with inputs and previous state
apply_agent_forward_step: apply a forward step of the agent using params, inputs, and previous state
warmup_agent: warm up an AlphaStarAgent by running a dummy forward pass and returning parameters
